'''Mala Blen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and the older sister of [[Aola Blen]]. Together, the Twi'leks ruled [[Thaere Privo]] in a complex interplay of power politics. The sisters had some contact with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]] from the neighboring [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. In public, Mala often expressed disdain for the Hutt and his organization, but is was rumored that in private, Mala made extended visits to the Hutt's court, bringing a range of delicacies to hand feed to the crime lord.

Shortly after Riboga's departure from the Cularin system, both the Blen sisters died, and the control of Thaere Privo shifted to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bal Ferensil]].
